# Files and directories left out of the coverage denominator.
#
# Single source of truth: .github/ci-scripts/coverage.py (CI job `coverage` and
# `make coverage`) reads it, and codecov.yml `ignore:` must list exactly the
# same entries (coverage.py --check-codecov fails otherwise).
# Patterns are repository-relative, gitignore-like: `*` stays inside a path
# segment, `**` crosses directories, an entry also covers everything below it.
# Only exclude what is not product behaviour: generated code, test helpers and
# mocks, documentation stubs, developer-only tools. Never exclude product code
# to raise the number. coverage.py also fails when a file carrying a
# "Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT." header is not listed here.

# Generated: swagger docs (swag init), antlr parser of the rules engine.
cmd/relayproxy/docs/
rules/parser/jsonquery_lexer.go
rules/parser/jsonquery_parser.go
rules/parser/jsonquery_visitor.go

# Test helpers and mocks (shared fixtures, gopherstack/testcontainers helpers).
testutils/
modules/core/testutils/
cmd/relayproxy/testdata/

# Type-only structs that exist to feed swagger; no behaviour.
cmd/relayproxy/modeldocs/

# Developer-only tools, not shipped: schema generator, rules demo CLI.
cmd/jsonschema-generator/
rules/cmd/
